Subject: Group briefing: Shared product showcase — slot coordination

Hi Olivia / Tom —

Thanks again for your interest in a joint walkthrough of Redwood Inference. We want to run a compact 45-minute group showcase (15m overview, 25m demo + Q&A, 5m next steps) that brings together a couple of customers with overlapping use cases so we can cover serving performance, deployment options, and cost controls.

To make this easy, would any of these times work for you next week? I listed PST / EST conversions below. Please reply with 1, 2, or 3 (or suggest another slot).

Options (45m):
1) Tue Mar 2 — 9:00am PST / 12:00pm EST
2) Wed Mar 3 — 10:00am PST / 1:00pm EST
3) Thu Mar 4 — 5:00pm PST / 8:00pm EST (later window for APAC-friendly participants)

Notes:
- Plan: short intros -> 15m product + architecture -> 25m live demo (low-latency examples + dedicated vs hosted) -> 5m next steps. Agenda attached (demo-agenda.pdf).
- We'll host on Zoom; I'll send an invite once we lock a time (invite.ics attached as placeholder).
- If multiple people from your side will join, please list names/roles so we can tailor examples.

Ben / Laura / Neha — looped you in to help decide whether to run a single consolidated session or split regional tracks if we get mixed timezone constraints.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Thanks Vivek — appreciate the quick options.

Short answers:
- We have two folks who will join: Olivia Park (Head of ML) and Daniel Serrano (Infra lead).
- We prefer mid-day EST windows. Option 2 (Wed Mar 3 — 1:00pm EST) looks best on our side. Option 1 is doable if absolutely necessary. Option 3 is tough for us (evening PST).

If you prefer to split into region-specific sessions, we're flexible but would prioritize getting a single session that works for NA participants.

Tom (cc'd) will confirm Brightform's availability — he may prefer Option 1 because of an internal cadence. If we do one session, Option 2 is our pick.

Thanks — I'll block tentative time on our side until you confirm.

Olivia Park

- Evening track suggestion: Thu Mar 4 — 5:00pm PST / Fri Mar 5 — 9:00am IST (if APAC needs line-up)

If Olivia and Brightform confirm they'd rather do one NA session, I'm fine with Wed Mar 3 — 10am PST. Otherwise I'll create two calendar invites and route registrants to the appropriate bridge.
